name: Set 9: Vaal River Vibes
description: Marathons, Superhero Sagas, Shooters & Mighty Rivers

questions.q: In South Africa, what is a 750ml glass bottle of beer commonly called in bar slang?
questions.fact: A 750ml bottle is traditionally known as a 'quart' (or 'large').

questions.q: How many seconds are in five full minutes?
questions.fact: 5 x 60 = 300 seconds.

questions.q: What is the primary spirit used to make a classic Cuba Libre cocktail?
questions.fact: Rum, cola, and fresh lime juice.

questions.q: Which bird is the national bird of South Africa?
questions.fact: The elegant Blue Crane (Anthropoides paradiseus).

questions.q: How many players are on a standard basketball court for one team during play?
questions.fact: 5 players per team on the court.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Ireland?
questions.fact: Dublin: home of St. James's Gate Brewery (Guinness).

questions.q: What is the common name for the dry meat snack made by stuffing sheep or beef casing with seasoned ground meat and drying it?
questions.fact: Droëwors.

questions.q: What color is the middle stripe on the national flag of Germany?
questions.fact: Black, Red, Gold from top to bottom.

questions.q: In pool or billiards, what ball is traditionally solid black with the number 8?
questions.fact: The 8-ball is the black ball potted last to win.

questions.q: What is the traditional name for the morning alcoholic beverage made with tomato juice, vodka, Worcestershire sauce, and Tabasco?
questions.fact: Classic hangover remedy cocktail.

questions.q: Between which two KwaZulu-Natal cities is the world-famous Comrades Marathon run annually over approximately 89 kilometers?
questions.fact: The world's largest and oldest ultramarathon, alternating between Up Run and Down Run.

questions.q: Which South African running legend won the Comrades Marathon a record nine times between 1981 and 1992?
questions.fact: Bruce Fordyce: the undisputed king of the Comrades Marathon.

questions.q: Which South African sprinter shattered Michael Johnson's 17-year-old world record to win 400m Olympic Gold in Rio 2016 in 43.03 seconds from lane 8?
questions.fact: Wayde van Niekerk's mind-blowing 43.03 run from the outside lane in Rio.

questions.q: What is the standard official length of a full marathon race in kilometers?
questions.fact: 42.195 km (26 miles 385 yards), standardized at the 1908 London Olympics.

questions.q: Which South African marathon race held in Cape Town every Easter weekend is famed as 'The World's Most Beautiful Marathon'?
questions.fact: 56 km ultramarathon over Chapman's Peak and Constantia Nek.

questions.q: Which South African male swimmer won Olympic Gold in the 100m breaststroke at the 2012 London Olympics in world record time?
questions.fact: Cameron van der Burgh touched the wall in 58.46 seconds.

questions.q: In rugby union, which position on the pitch wears the number 9 jersey?
questions.fact: Scrumhalf wears number 9; flyhalf wears number 10.

questions.q: Which famous canoe marathon is held annually on the Msunduzi and Mngeni Rivers in KwaZulu-Natal over three gruelling days?
questions.fact: Founded in 1951 by Ian Player, paddling and portaging between Pietermaritzburg and Durban.

questions.q: Which country won the FIFA Men's World Cup in Qatar in December 2022, captained by Lionel Messi?
questions.fact: Argentina defeated France in a thrilling penalty shootout.

questions.q: In cricket, how many runs are scored if a batter hits the ball and runs between the wickets three times without the ball crossing the boundary?
questions.fact: Each completed run across the pitch equals 1 run.

questions.q: In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what is the real identity of Iron Man?
questions.fact: Played by Robert Downey Jr.

questions.q: In Star Wars, who is revealed to be Luke Skywalker's father in The Empire Strikes Back?
questions.fact: 'No, I am your father.'

questions.q: Which 1985 adventure film starred Michael J. Fox as high school student Marty McFly travelling back to 1955?
questions.fact: Directed by Robert Zemeckis.

questions.q: What fictional African country is ruled by King T'Challa in Marvel's Black Panther?
questions.fact: 'Wakanda Forever!' Rich in the alien metal vibranium.

questions.q: Who directed the 1994 cult masterpiece Pulp Fiction?
questions.fact: Won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1994.

questions.q: In the Batman universe, what is the name of the fictional city protected by the Caped Crusader?
questions.fact: Metropolis is Superman's home; Gotham belongs to Batman.

questions.q: Which actor played Indiana Jones in Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981)?
questions.fact: Harrison Ford wielded the fedora and whip.

questions.q: In the Harry Potter series, what platform at King's Cross station does the Hogwarts Express depart from?
questions.fact: Hidden behind the barrier between platforms 9 and 10.

questions.q: What British rock band wrote and performed the iconic soundtrack to the 1986 film Highlander, including 'Princes of the Universe' and 'Who Wants to Live Forever'?
questions.fact: Included on Queen's 1986 album A Kind of Magic.

questions.q: What is the name of the green ogre who lives in a swamp alongside a talking Donkey in DreamWorks' hit animated film?
questions.fact: Voiced by Mike Myers (with Eddie Murphy as Donkey).

questions.q: What South African shooter is served as a double shot of Klipdrift brandy accompanied by a chaser can of Passion Fruit soda?
questions.fact: A 'Suitcase': shot of Klipdrift followed by Passion Fruit soda.

questions.q: What shooter is made by layering peppermint green liqueur with cream liqueur (Amarula)?
questions.fact: The national shot of South Africa: green and gold in a glass.

questions.q: What triangular pastry snack filled with curried potatoes, peas, or spicy mince is beloved at South African parties?
questions.fact: Crispy golden fried samosas.

questions.q: What cocktail is made with white rum, coconut cream, and pineapple juice, garnished with a pineapple wedge?
questions.fact: National drink of Puerto Rico since 1978.

questions.q: Which brand of South African cider was launched in 1996 with a famous dry taste and lemon wedge in the neck?
questions.fact: Savanna Dry: 'It's dry, but you can drink it.'

questions.q: What popular bar snack consists of seasoned pork skin deep-fried until crisp and crackling?
questions.fact: Crispy salted pork scratchings.

questions.q: What Italian bitter liqueur, vibrant red in color, is the key ingredient in a Negroni cocktail alongside gin and sweet vermouth?
questions.fact: Equal parts Campari, sweet red vermouth, and gin.

questions.q: What is the classic Cape Malay dish made of spiced minced meat baked with an egg custard topping and bay leaves?
questions.fact: South Africa's national dish, fragrant with curry spices and raisins.

questions.q: In a bar, what term is used for draught beer served directly from the tap into a glass pitcher built for sharing at the table?
questions.fact: A beer jug or pitcher, typically 1.5 to 2 liters.

questions.q: What spicy tomato cocktail mix originated in Calgary, Canada, made with clam broth and tomato juice?
questions.fact: Made with Mott's Clamato juice.

questions.q: What major South African river forms the provincial boundary between Gauteng and the Free State, feeding the Vaal Dam?
questions.fact: 'Vaal' is Dutch for drab or pale, referring to the grayish silt color of the water.

questions.q: What is the largest lake in Africa by surface area, shared by Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania?
questions.fact: Spanning over 68,000 square kilometers, it is the main source of the White Nile.

questions.q: What is the highest mountain peak in the world above sea level, located on the border between Nepal and China?
questions.fact: Stands 8,848.86 meters above sea level in the Himalayas.

questions.q: Which major river flows through London before emptying into the North Sea?
questions.fact: The River Thames flows past the Houses of Parliament and Tower Bridge.

questions.q: What South African town in the Free State is located right on the banks of the Vaal River and is famous for art galleries, breweries, and antique shops?
questions.fact: Parys on the Vaal: a bustling weekend getaway.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Norway?
questions.fact: Oslo: situated at the head of the Oslofjord.

questions.q: What is the largest ocean on Earth, covering more surface area than all of the world's landmasses combined?
questions.fact: Covering over 165 million square kilometers.

questions.q: Which mountain range stretches through Switzerland, France, Italy, Austria, and Germany?
questions.fact: Highest peak is Mont Blanc (4,808m).

questions.q: What South African town in the Western Cape is world-famous for its dramatic red rock cliffs and rock-climbing routes?
questions.fact: Montagu on Route 62: a climbing and hot springs haven.

questions.q: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
questions.fact: Wellington is the world's southernmost sovereign capital city.

questions.q: What is the official world record time set by Wayde van Niekerk in the 400m sprint in Rio 2016 in seconds?
questions.fact: 43.03 seconds on 14 August 2016.

questions.q: Approximately how many kilometers long is the full length of the Vaal River from its source near Breyten to its confluence with the Orange River?
questions.fact: Approximately 1,120 km in length.

questions.q: In what calendar year was the first ever Comrades Marathon run between Pietermaritzburg and Durban?
questions.fact: 24 May 1921, founded by Vic Clapham.
